properties.description:
Review the progressively built review/annotation mockups with the user through the UI editor in Review → Changes. Discuss and revise the mockups until the user agrees on the next implementable scope. Preserve artifact versions and linked feedback, including the discussion work already attached to this review.

Review behavior, compact layout, component reuse, context and annotation handling, and any architecture or invariant detail the user needs. Update the mockup when feedback materially changes the proposal. Human approval is explicit; neither task completion nor a generated artifact implies acceptance.
properties.title: Review and iterate on review-surface mockups in the UI editor
